bish8 -o ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT ANDEASEMENT AGREEMENT is made as of this 13 day of September, 2017 (this “Agreement"), by SREP 10TH AVENUE VENTURE LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address c/o Soundview Real Estate Partners, 201 Tresser Blvd., Stamford, CT 06901 ("SREP"). RECITALS: SREP is the owner in fee simple of that certain parcel of land lying and being in the City, State and County of New York designated as Lot 39 in Block 693 on the Tax Map of the City of New' York, New York County (the “Tax Map") and known by the street address of 504 West               annexed hereto (the “Lot 39 Land"), together with the building and improvements thereon (the "Lot 39 Improvements"); the Lot 39 Land and Lot 39 Improvements herein being referred to collectively as the “Lot 39 Premises" and SREP, in its capacity as the owner of the Lot 39 Premises, “Lot 39 Owner"). SREP is the owner in fee simple of that certain parcel of land lying and being in the City, State.and County of New York designated as Lot 37 in Block 693 on the Tax Map and known by the street address of 500 West 22nd Street, New York, New York, which land is more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto (the “Lot 37 Land"), together with the improvements thereon (said existing improvements being herein referred to as the "Lot 37 Existing Building"; together with any future replacements thereof or additions thereto whether made by Lot 37 Owner (as hereinafter defined) or Lot 37 Owner's successors or assigns, and including, without limitation, the Lot 37 New Building (as hereinafter defined), collectively, the “Lot_37 Improvements"; the Lot 37 Land, Lot 37 Existing Building, the Lot 37 New Building and the Lot 37 Improvements herein being referred to collectively as the "Lot 37 Premises" and SREP, in its capacity as the owner of the Lot 37 Premises, "Lot 37 Owner"). Lot 37 Owner intends to demolish all or a portion of the Lot 37 Existing Building and construct a new building and improvements on the Lot 37 Land or renovate and/or expand the Lot 37 Existing Building (said new or expanded building and improvements, together with any related improvements, additions, renovations, . alterations, restorations, repairs and reconstructions thereto whether made by Lot 37 Owner or Lot 37 Owner's successors or assigns, herein being referred to collectively as “Lot 37 New Building") with a bulk (as hereinafter defined) in excess of the bulk presently permitted to be constructed on Lot 37 Premises under the ZoningResolution (as hereinafter defined). The certification by SP Wong Architect PLLC dated May 5, 2017 (attached hereto as Schedule 1) certifies that the Lot 39 Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are 1,591 zoning square feet. Pursuant to Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, Lot 39 Owner and Lot 37 Owner have executed and delivered a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration"), intended to be recorded simultaneously herewith, confirming the existence'of a single combined zoning lot (the “Combined Zoning Lot") consisting of Lot 37 Land and Lot 39 Land in order to make available to Lot 37 Owner all of the Lot 39 Excess Development Rights. 092267.000003 610537733.3

Lot 37 Owner has caused all parties in interest (as hereinafter defined) to the Lot 37 Premises and Lot 39 Owner has caused all parties in interest to Lot 39 Premises, in each case as shown on the Parties-in-Interest Certification of First American Title Insurance Company, a copy of which is annexed hereto as Exhibit C, either to join in the Declaration (or a previous Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions affecting the Combined Zoning Lot) or to execute a Waiver of Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions. : The Lot 39 Land is contiguous with the Lot 37 Land for at least ten (10) linear feet, and the Lot.39 Land and the Lot 37 Land are all within a single block. Lot 39 Owner and Lot 37 Owner wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Combined Zoning Lot and other matters, and wish.to provide to the maximum extent possible for each to exercise its rights in the future without having to seek any consent, approval or other action from the other. NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing and the mutual agreements and covenants herein contained, Lot 39 Owner and Lot 37 Owner hereby agree as follows: 1. DEFINITIONS. Defined terms used in this Agreement shall, unless the context otherwise requires, have the following meaning: 1.1 “Additional Development'Rights"shall mean any additional Development Rights that may become available to the Lot 37 Premises or the Lot 39 Premises or the Combined Zoning Lot (either by expansion of the Combined Zoning Lot by adding Additional Parcels by special permit, by variance, or by other procedure or transfer allowed under the provisions of the Zoning Resolution or any Governmental Agency).      sd       ,   contiguous with the Combined Zoning Lot for at least ten (10) linear feet and not now part of the Combined Zoning Lot. 1.3 “Alterations"- See Section 8.7. 1.4 "Approval" or "Approvals" - See Section 7.1.  1.5 "Approving Agency” shall mean an agency of the City of New York or any other Governmental Agency that takes an action that creates Upzoning Rights.
